_what: TikTok script (65 to 90 s) for a topical video: GTA 6, what is confirmed before launch (Nolan 11/13: 'Wanna do another today to see' / 'Do all'). Facts only from research/108-topical-three-factpack.md. Checked by a second model 11/13 (research/109): cleared with fixes, all applied here.
_rules: Jokes aim at the company's or the public figure's own reported conduct and at Meatball; never at the viewer, a group, the workers, the women in the reports or anyone's family. No woman from the reports is named. Unproven claims stay attributed (reported, alleged, not confirmed). A line that names a country is said clean. No joke adds a number, a cause, a danger or a claim the fact line does not carry. All drawn: no logos, no game footage, no game characters or art. Captions soften swear spelling (cap_swap). Title, description and caption are clean.

lines.say: GTA 6 comes out November nineteenth. Here's what's actually fucking confirmed.
lines.vis: Frame 0: Meatball in front of a big wall calendar, NOV 19 circled in red, a drawn generic game console at his feet. No logos.

lines.say: Meatball already called in sick. For the whole damn month.
lines.vis: Meatball on the phone faking a cough, blanket on, controller hidden behind his back.

lines.say: It slipped from fall 2025 to May 2026, then to November. Two delays. Meatball's been late on rent more than that.
lines.vis: Three calendar pages; the first two get crossed out. Then a landlord note on Meatball's door.

lines.say: The price: seventy-nine ninety-nine. Ultimate edition, ninety-nine ninety-nine. Meatball's selling his couch. Sauce lives in that fucking couch.
lines.vis: Two price tags. Meatball drags a couch with a FOR SALE sign; the orange cat, Sauce, sits on it unmoved.

lines.say: The download is reported at up to two hundred twelve gigabytes. Meatball's Wi-Fi just filed a fucking complaint.
lines.vis: A download bar crawling at 1 percent; the router smokes.

lines.say: And the box in stores? Rockstar says it's a download code, not a disc. Basically a box of fucking air.
lines.vis: Meatball opens a game box: a small slip of paper floats out, nothing else.

lines.say: It launches on PS5 and Xbox Series consoles. No PC version announced. Meatball's gaming PC is now a very expensive fucking lamp.
lines.vis: Two generic consoles glow; a PC tower with a lampshade on it.

lines.say: Meanwhile, more than sixteen hundred Rockstar workers in the UK can vote on union recognition, the union says. November twelfth to twenty-sixth. Right through launch week.
lines.vis: A ballot box with a calendar strip NOV 12-26; NOV 19 marked in the middle.

lines.say: Rockstar's head of publishing told Bloomberg: if they want a union, they will have a union. The union says staff fired last year were targeted for organizing. Take-Two says it was gross misconduct. A tribunal hasn't ruled.
card: "IF THEY WANT A UNION, THEY WILL HAVE A UNION"
ROCKSTAR HEAD OF PUBLISHING TO BLOOMBERG
lines.vis: Quote card; then two speech bubbles facing each other, UNION SAYS / TAKE-TWO SAYS. No faces of real people.

lines.say: Meatball tried to unionize his cat, Sauce. Sauce walked out. Immediately.
lines.vis: Meatball holds a tiny picket sign up to Sauce; Sauce turns and leaves the frame.

lines.say: You play Jason and Lucia in Vice City, in the state of Leonida, basically Florida, outlets say. Meatball's banned from the real one.
lines.vis: A generic drawn neon skyline with palm trees at sunset (our own drawing, no game art, no characters); a BANNED stamp on Meatball's photo at a state-line sign.

lines.say: So are you playing day one, or waiting for reviews like a damn adult? Because
lines.vis: Back to the frame-0 calendar and pose so the loop into g1 is seamless; question in a top-corner pill.
